extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral investigators preparing NIH K99/R00 (and similar) grant applications and institutional administrators/reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and exemplars for the 'Facilities & Other Resources' and related Senior/Key Person/Profile and biosketch sections of an NIH-style K99/R00 grant application, describing institutional environment, core services, equipment and personnel support. Useful for applicants documenting capacity and reviewers assessing institutional resources and investigator qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources — Center for Research on End-of-Life Care (CREC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Center for Research on End-of-Life Care: Weill Cornell Medicine (WCM) has provided unprecedented medical school support for the establishment of the Center for Research on End-of-Life Care (CREC)... CREC is dedicated to the discovery of mechanisms and the testing of interventions to improve the quality of life and care of terminally ill patients and their family caregivers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document the Center's mission, institutional approval, start-up and existing funding, leadership (co-directors), and how CREC's infrastructure (multidisciplinary faculty, coordinators, statisticians, web-developers, transcription services, database housing, pilot data, equipment) will be leveraged to support the proposed project. List specific past grants and how funds supported infrastructure (e.g., software, SEER-Medicare data, web/DB development).

rubrics_metrics.name: Laboratory / Animal resources — Not applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: Laboratory: N/A to this study. Animal: N/A to this study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If laboratory or animal resources are not applicable, explicitly state 'N/A' as in this application. For applicable projects, provide facility descriptions, biosafety level, animal housing, and relevant certifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer and Software Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Dr. Luth has access to a Cornell networked laptop and/or desktop computer with secure access to the Internet, equipped with office software (e.g. Microsoft Office, Outlook, Endnote), e-mail and support for statistical package and related software to analyze and present results generated from study data. CREC has extensive software (e.g., SAS, SYSTAT, SPSS, Endnote, S-Plus, M-Plus, Visio, C++, R)... The online Qualtrics survey administration system ... will facilitate secure, cost-effective, standardized data collection. REDCap ... will be used as the database management system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List available hardware, network security, and specific statistical and programming software. Specify electronic data capture and management systems (Qualtrics, REDCap) and whom (institution/center) provides them. Explain how these tools will support data collection, storage, analysis, and security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office Space and Institutional Environment
rubrics_metrics.description:
Office: Dr. Luth has an office within the Division of Geriatrics and Palliative Medicine and study personnel will have office space within the CREC. The WCM Department of Medicine recently completed a $10-million-dollar renovation ... dedicated suite of private offices, needed electronics and internet access and networking capabilities, and conference room.
Institutional Environment: Weill Cornell Medicine ... committed to excellence in research, education, patient care ... WCM is the #9 ranked medical college in medical research ... affiliated with NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital ... accredited ... provides training and education for medical students, graduate students and post-doctoral fellows; has >1000 full-time faculty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe assigned office and administrative space, renovations or dedicated facilities, institutional rankings/accreditation, faculty size, and other features that demonstrate a supportive research environment. Explain how the institutional environment will contribute to project success and trainee development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Resources and Access to Patient Populations
rubrics_metrics.description: New York-Presbyterian Hospital (NYPH): ... a 2,224-bed university teaching hospital ... provides state-of-the-art inpatient, ambulatory and preventive care ... the Hospital and its affiliates provide the most comprehensive, high quality services ... Through the New York-Presbyterian Healthcare Network ... consists of more than 150 participating organizations including 32 hospitals, 6 long-term care facilities, 12 home health agencies ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document access to clinical sites, patient volumes, specialty centers, and affiliated networks that enable recruitment and study conduct. Provide concrete figures (beds, visits) and describe how hospital systems and affiliates will support recruitment, referrals, and clinical collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruitment Sites and Letters of Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Irving Sherwood Wright Center on Aging ... has confirmed his support for the center to be a recruitment site for the proposed research (see letter of support). Cornell Internal Medical Associates (CIMA) ... the Medical Director ... has confirmed his willingness for the practice to serve as a recruitment site for the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include named recruitment sites and explicit letters of support confirming willingness to recruit participants. Describe practice populations and relevance to the study sample. Cite letters in appendices/attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training Resources for Investigators and Trainees
rubrics_metrics.description: Cornell University and WCM provide extensive training opportunities ... formal courses, grand rounds presentations, and clinical case conferences. Training resources ... include mental and physical health of older adults; intervention development, implementation, and evaluation; sociological and epidemiological perspectives on aging; biostatistics; leadership and grant writing skills. Courses offered at the Ithaca campus are teleconferenced ... materials are available on Blackboard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List institutional training offerings, course topics, seminar series, distance-learning options, and mechanisms for skills development (e.g., grant writing workshops). Explain access for the candidate and how training supports project aims and career development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Library and Information Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Library Facilities ... Samuel J. Wood Library and the C.V. Starr Biomedical Information Center ... houses over 150,000 volumes and subscribes to over 1,500 printed and 4,800 electronic journals. The library ... provides computer-generated literature searches, translations, and inter-library loans. Medical graphics and photographic/audiovisual facilities provide a wide range of art, photographic, and audio-visual services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe library holdings, electronic journal access, inter-library loan, literature search services, and media/graphics support. Indicate collaborations with other libraries or shared databases when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Research Methodology Core Facility Services
rubrics_metrics.description: The Clinical Research Methodology Core Facility ... contains the requisite expertise and methodological skills for clinical research. ... consultative services to investigators in: biostatistics; observational/ epidemiologic research; clinical trials; outcomes research; health services research; health/ pharmaco-economics; behavioral research; diagnostic testing/screening; and program evaluation. Core consultation services include: statistical analysis/modeling; sample size/power analysis; study design; protocol design/research planning; database design/management; questionnaire development; cost-effectiveness analysis; decision analysis/evidence-based medicine; definition of measurable objectives; and standards/goal setting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Spell out available methodological expertise, list specific services (sample size/power, protocol design, database management, stat modeling), and indicate whether subsidized or how to access. Demonstrate how core support reduces project risk and strengthens study design and analysis plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of Clinical Trials Administration (OCTA) Services
rubrics_metrics.description: The OCTA ... streamlines the clinical research process and offers a wide range of services, resources and training. Services provided by the OCTA include: clinical trials grants and contracts, budgeting and billing services, protocol feasibility review and budget development, subsidized biostatistical support, and bioethical consultation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document institutional offices that assist with trial administration, contracting, budgets, billing, feasibility, biostatistics and ethics. Clarify what support is subsidized and describe access procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Commitment to Early Stage Investigators
rubrics_metrics.description: WCM, the Department of Medicine, and the Institutional Commitment to Early Stage Investigators: Division of Geriatrics and Palliative Medicine have strong institutional support and mentorship for junior investigators ... Resources include financial support to undertake additional coursework and training workshops; assigned office space and software relevant to the conduct of research; access to administrative support from research managers and research assistants; specific training on responsible conduct of research; and protected, salary-supported time in which to develop research. ... formal didactic/seminar series ... monthly Grand Rounds, monthly journal club, monthly Work in Progress meeting ... Tri-Institutional Course in the Responsible Conduct of Research ... workshops and seminars on grant writing and preparation, professional development, and manuscript preparation and dissemination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe concrete commitments to trainee development: protected time, salary support, mentorship assignments, administrative support, dedicated coursework, seminar series and other career-development activities. Provide examples that demonstrate sustained institutional investment in early-stage investigators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment — Not applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: EQUIPMENT: Not applicable to this study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If specialized equipment is not required, explicitly note 'Not applicable.' For projects requiring equipment, list available major items, location, access, and instrumentation support staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) — Required Fields and Attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) PROFILE - Project Director/Principal Investigator ... fields: Prefix, First Name*, Middle Name, Last Name*, Position/Title*, Organization Name*, Department, Division, Street, City, State, Country, Zip, Phone Number*, E-Mail*, Project Role*: PD/PI, Attach Biographical Sketch*: File Name: Bio_Luth.pdf, Attach Current & Pending Support: File Name: Tracking Number: GRANT12970300. Funding Opportunity Number: PA-19-129. Received Date: 2019-11-12T13:38:54.000-05:00.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all required contact and role fields for senior/key personnel. Attach biographical sketches and current & pending support documents. Include tracking/funding opportunity numbers and receipt dates. Ensure project roles are correctly designated (PD/PI, mentor, co-mentor, other professional).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch Content — Personal Statement and Education/Training
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH: PERSONAL STATEMENT: Example: I received a Ph.D. in Sociology ... My long-term goal is to become an independent investigator ... The proposed K99/R00 ... will provide me with the training, mentorship, protected time and professional development I need ... Education/Training: list institutions, degrees, completion dates and fields. Positions and Honors: list positions and professional memberships, honors and reviewers roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise personal statement linking prior work, expertise, and suitability for the proposed research and career goals. Include detailed education/training history, positions, professional memberships, review activities, and honors. Cite relevant publications and prior work that position the candidate to succeed.
